verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents escalation policies that define who is alerted and in what order until the incident is acknowledged. Its on-call guide shows a time-delayed escalation from the on-call person to the whole team (e.g. after 3 minutes). Explicit repeat rounds are not documented, and multi-step configuration detail is thin. Missing for 10: documented repeat/loop rounds of the policy, detailed per-step delay and fallback-responder configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, escalation policies walk unacknowledged pages through multiple steps — delays, fallback responders, and repeat rounds — until someone acknowledges

citations.quote: It defines who will be alerted and in what order, continuing until the incident is acknowledged.
The current on-call person is notified first. If they don’t acknowledge the incident (for example, after 3 minutes), it escalates and notifies everyone on the team.
Configure complex rules for escalating incidents based on time, team availability, and incident origin.
